products.short_description: Protect Azure and on-prem workloads — deploy Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery with policies, replication, and tested failover plans.
products.description:
Protect Azure and on-prem workloads — deploy Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery with policies, replication, and tested failover plans.

Hoping your VMs are backed up is not a DR strategy. This solution deploys Azure Backup (Recovery Services/Backup vaults, VM/files/SQL/blob protection, policies, soft delete + immutability) and Azure Site Recovery (replication, recovery plans, and failover/failback) so workloads are provably protected with defined RPO/RTO.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Recovery Services / Backup vaults with soft delete and immutability
  • Backup policies for Azure VMs, Files, SQL-in-VM, and blobs
  • Azure Site Recovery replication (Azure-to-Azure / on-prem-to-Azure)
  • Recovery plans with sequencing, scripts, and test failover
  • RPO/RTO targets, alerting, and a restore/failover runbook

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Provable protection with defined RPO/RTO — Azure Backup and Site Recovery deployed, policy-driven, and test-failover proven, not assumed.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • BCKDR-Discovery.ps1 — Inventory the Azure estate and flag backup/DR coverage gaps
    • BCKDR-EnableProtection.ps1 — Assign backup policies and enable protection on
    • BCKDR-Report.ps1 — Compile estate-wide Azure Backup + Site Recovery posture
    • BCKDR-Validate.ps1 — Validate vault hardening, policy coverage, and ASR health;

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
